name: Ptolemy
description: An attack that places you at the centre of the world, calculating the enemy's movement to land a precise blow. Deals damage to the enemy.

name: Hess
description: An attack likened to the force of the mantle moving the seabed. Deals heavy damage to the enemy.

name: Wegener
description: A powerful attack likened to a force great enough to move continents. Deals very heavy damage.

name: Van der Waals
description: A skill that gathers the faint energy scattered through the body into a single point to produce great power. Raises attack for a time.

name: Faraday's Eye
description: A skill that finds the enemy's opening with concentration keen enough to make out atomic structure. Raises accuracy for a time.

name: Boyle's Law
description: Just as the volume and pressure of a gas are inversely proportional at a constant temperature, this dangerous skill trades defence for greater attack for a time.

name: Bohr
description: Quantises angular momentum to raise attack.

name: Mendeleev
description: Organises every pattern of attack into a system and strikes precisely to suit the situation, raising accuracy.

name: Blessing of the Stromatolite
description: Draws on the vitality of the stromatolite, which holds the secret of life's origin and history on this planet, raising maximum HP.

name: Appassionato
description: Music played with passion attacks the enemy. Mula's basic attack skill. Deals damage to the enemy.

name: Agitato
description: Batters the enemy with a fierce beat. Deals heavy damage.

name: Leggiero
description: Plays a light-footed melody that lifts the hearts of those nearby. Raises evasion for a time.

name: Accelerando
description: Raises the tempo little by little until you fight to a rhythm faster than you realise. Shortens cooldown for a time.

name: Spiritoso
description: A cheerful, lively beat restores the spirits of those nearby. Recovers HP.

name: Cantabile
description: Slips past the enemy's attacks with movements as smooth as singing. Raises evasion.

name: Prestissimo
description: Pushes your body's rhythm to its limit and plays an extremely fast melody. Shortens cooldown.

name: Scratch
description: An attack applying the scratch technique, where layered paint is scraped away to reveal the colour beneath. Rakes the enemy with the blade's edge for damage.

name: Decollage
description: A skill applying decollage, the technique of tearing away what has been pasted down. A destructive attack that rends, batters and cuts. Deals heavy damage.

name: Etching
description: A terrifying skill that reproduces copperplate etching with a blade: ground is laid on the plate, the motif drawn with a needle, and acid does the rest. Deals very heavy damage.

name: Collage
description: A skill that gathers whatever lies nearby on the blade's tip and binds it into a wall. Raises defence temporarily.

name: Sfumato
description: A skill applying sfumato, the blurring of colour boundaries, to make an attack hard to see coming. Raises critical temporarily.

name: Gestalt
description: A skill that empties the mind until the image of yourself perceived by the senses turns transparent. You are invincible for a time, but cannot use a finisher while it lasts.

name: Assemblage
description: A skill that gathers up objects lying about and forms them into a kind of armour. Raises defence.

name: Frottage
description: A skill that brings the potential hidden inside you to the surface, the way frottage lifts an image. Raises critical.

name: Vorticism
description: A skill that circulates your energy in a vortex to raise your metabolism. Raises maximum HP.

name: Weber's Law
description: A spirit user's basic skill, using the control learned from commanding weak spirits to make a stronger one attack. Deals damage to the enemy.

name: Albino Attack
description: A skill that raises a spirit's power until your whole body shines white. Deals heavy damage.

name: ATP Activation
description: Activates the muscle-contraction energy released by breaking down adenosine triphosphate, raising attack speed for a time.

name: Haemoglobin Boost
description: A skill that increases haemoglobin in the blood, improving oxygen supply so you can run faster. Raises movement speed for a time.

name: TCA Acceleration
description: A skill that accelerates the body's metabolic cycle to raise recovery dramatically. Raises natural HP recovery for a time.

name: Sutton
description: A skill that manipulates the genetic information in your chromosomes to reach a speed beyond your limits. Raises attack speed.

name: Myoglobin Boost
description: A skill that increases myoglobin, raising the oxygen held in muscle tissue so you can run faster. Raises movement speed.
